title: Special Campaign 6
subtitle: MDoNER Steps Up Drive for Cleaner Workplaces and Greater Administrative Efficiency
body_text:
The Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (MDoNER) and its organisations are undertaking Special Campaign 6 in accordance with the guidelines issued by the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG). From 05–15 October 2026, t he Campaign will seek to translate Swachhata into sustained administrative action by promoting workplace cleanliness, optimising available space, reducing pendency and strengthening systems for effective management of records, files and obsolete material. Officers and staff across the Ministry and its organisations are being encouraged to participate actively in the Campaign and contribute towards creating cleaner, more organised and efficient workplaces.
Building on the achievements of Special Campaign 5.0 , concluded on 31 October 2025, MDoNER and its organisations are continuing their efforts towards cleanliness and administrative efficiency. The Campaign witnessed 36 cleanliness drives, freeing of 3,664 sq. ft. of office space, disposal of 46 public grievances and 3 VIP references, review and weeding of 217 physical files and 32 e-files, and generation of ₹7,82,814 through disposal of scrap and unserviceable items.
Under Special Campaign 6, these efforts will be further strengthened through a cleanliness drive in the office premises, corridors, common areas, staircases and surrounding areas, activities such as the Clean Desk Campaign, identification and review of old physical files/records, review and closure of eligible e-files, identification of obsolete/damaged furniture, equipment and scrap, segregation of e-waste and other scrap for disposal as per prescribed procedure, review of pending references/pendency cases for time-bound disposal.
The Campaign is expected to bring about visible and measurable improvements across the Ministry and its organisations. By combining cleanliness with systematic administrative reforms, Special Campaign 6 aims to ensure that Swachhata becomes an integral part of day-to-day office management rather than remaining a one-time exercise. MDoNER and its organisations remain committed to sustaining the improvements achieved through the Campaign and fostering a cleaner, more efficient, organised and environmentally responsible workplace.
